machine: Apple Silicon, 16 GB RAM, no NVIDIA GPU
method: transformers eager (fp32) vs onnxruntime quantized; repeated synthetic Finnish corpus; CPU = all cores
conclusions: Naive path (transformers pipeline, device=mps) is a trap: ~54 min/MB, MPS slower than CPU due to MoE CPU-fallback.
Quantized ONNX (int8/q4) + batching is ~8x faster: ~2 min/MB, ~3.9 GB RAM, no GPU.
Cheap-and-fast holds for interactive per-message redaction (~0.3s / 1.5 kB message, local, free); NOT for bulk on one machine (~2 min/MB optimized).
